rationale: The assistant went straight to the sensible first step (thermostat setting, Super Cool, food pressed against the rear vents), which matched the ground truth, and the customer confirmed the dial was on max and the fridge was rammed. It gave correct, hedged follow-up advice ('a thermostat/temperature sensor or air flap becomes more likely and would need an engineer') with no invented facts or part recommendations. Weaknesses: the first reply oddly begins with 'Also check', the attached card ('Fridge not cooling — simple checks first') addressed the wrong symptom and mentioned sealed-system/refrigerant work irrelevantly, and it never suggested a fridge thermometer to verify the result.
